title: AstroClassifier reproducibility archive: object-independent evaluation of small-data astronomical image classifiers
description:
Reproducibility archive for an object-independent evaluation of small-data astronomical image classifiers. It contains the implementation, frozen experimental protocols, provenance records, predictions, aggregate results, manuscript, and reproducible figures for comparisons of a custom CNN–Transformer, ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16.

Versioned FITS products and materialized tensors are distributed as separate Dataset-v2 release assets and remain subject to the source-archive terms documented in datasets/DATA_USE.md.
